title: PDBe-KB superposition view
prompt: Open the PDBe-KB superposition view for human haemoglobin subunit alpha (UniProt P69905) on a white background.

provenance.source: PDBe-KB superposition view; no atom table (compared by settings)
provenance.derived: The July task loaded PDB entry 2HHB with superposition on. In pdbe-molstar 3.3.2 the superposition view takes a UniProt accession as moleculeId (spec.ts:103) and shows the PDBe-KB superposed entries for that protein; it does not align the chains of one entry. Compared by its settings (no atom table: the view's content comes from PDBe-KB at run time).
